titles: The boost that made fnatic forfeit a Major (CS:GO)
Olofboost: the most controversial round in CS:GO history
publish.description: Down 3–12 at a Major, then 13 rounds in a row. Was the forfeit fair? 👇

lines.say: Down three to twelve at a Major. Then thirteen rounds in a row.
lines.cap: Down 3–12 at a Major. Then 13 rounds in a row.

lines.say: November twenty-fourteen. DreamHack Winter, a Major.
Fnatic against Team LDLC. Deciding map: Overpass.
lines.cap: fnatic against Team LDLC. Deciding map: Overpass.

lines.say: Then a hidden spot. Thirteen rounds in a row. Sixteen to thirteen.
lines.cap: Then a hidden spot. 13 rounds in a row. 16–13.

cards.headline: PIXEL BOOST
cards.sub: A hidden ledge, seeing through the textures

lines.say: Olofmeister was boosted onto a hidden ledge. From there, he could see through the textures.
lines.cap: olofmeister was boosted onto a hidden ledge. From there, he could see through the textures.

lines.say: LDLC filed a protest. Fnatic answered with a counter-protest.
lines.cap: LDLC filed a protest. fnatic answered with a counter-protest.

cards.headline: REPLAY THE MAP
cards.sub: DreamHack orders Overpass to be replayed

lines.say: The admins ruled it illegal, and ordered the map replayed.
lines.cap: The admins ruled it illegal, and ordered the map replayed.

cards.headline: BACKLASH
cards.sub: Fans and players turn on fnatic

lines.say: Then came the backlash, from fans and from other players.
lines.cap: Then came the backlash, from fans and from other players.

lines.say: Fnatic refused. They forfeited instead. A first in Major history.
lines.cap: fnatic refused. They forfeited instead. A first in Major history.

lines.say: And Team LDLC went on to win the whole Major.
lines.cap: And Team LDLC went on to win the whole Major.
